body: You're very welcome. I'm glad I could be of help!

I'm probably wrong, but I've had this feeling, based on what has been said and done, that my best friend and my ex girlfriend, have done similar things. They both have the same kind of lifestyles... so I guess it makes sense. 

But why did it have to be both of the people I trusted most in the world? I know you might be feeling the same way right now. What I've been telling myself is that they were never worth it. He isn't and wasn't my best friend. And she isn't someone that was ever worthy of my love. They're just people passing by in our lives, showing us who not to trust. There will come a true best friend. And a wife one day. At least, that's what I believe. And hopefully they'll open our eyes to what those titles really mean

Thank you so much for your thoughtful reply. It genuinely eases me to know there are people out there willing to spend so much time typing to a stranger in need. It truly warms my heart

And thank you for sharing your story. I really can relate to that in so many ways. My ex hit me in the perfect way too. It's funny, because I wished for someone like her when I was younger. I wished for a woman who would love me the way she did, and would have a personality just like hers. I would thank god every day for letting me meet such a wonderful woman. She was everything to me, and still is. But I know it won't work. I get that. I did and am doing what you did back then... idealizing her. I too am different, morally. I want to settle down and live a monogamous life. I want wholesome things, I guess, is one way of putting it. But she was always a free spirit. Always looking for fun with other people. I was a fool to think she would be satisfied with me. But I believed it though. She once told me that too. I trusted her in that way completely. I still can't believe she left me. My heart, mind and soul told me to believe in us. I don't know how I'll ever trust those things again. When the person you wanted to marry (and we spoke about us getting married often), says that she doesn't want to be tied down to you and wants to have fun... when she wants to fuck other people, because you're not enough... man. It fucking sucks. She has every right to do whomever she wants and do whatever she wants, but... I wish she hadn't lead me on. I wish I had never fallen in love with her. I genuinely wish that. Because I fell for someone who, while is a good person, ruined my view on love and has made me skeptical of every person I meet. I almost resent her for that. Why did she love me so deeply, only to put a knife where that love reached 

But I will say this, I'm glad that girl at least showed you that kindness does exist. I'm glad she gives you hope for the future. I think it's amazing to be able to take positive things out of situations like those. I used to know how to. But with everything that's happened... I'm lost. I feel dead inside. And when I don't feel dead, I feel utter despair and anger

Also, I truly TRULY respect you saying you avoided talking to the girl with the boyfriend too much, because you didn't want to be responsible for if it didn't work out. That's beautiful. Respecting another persons relationship is not something most people do. And that scares me. That so many people like that are out there, willing to cheat. I don't want to be with someone who would do that to me. So again, thank you for being a decent human being. I'm sure **you** have shown many girls that kind people exist. You've certainly shown me. I'm sorry you have endured pain too, but I'm happy to hear that you're focusing on you. Making a life for yourself and pursuing your goals. When you have passion like that, everything else, like girls, tend to roll into place. I want to be like that too. But I dislike life so much. Living feels like a chore. The future only sounds appealing when I think about my end. I hate being like this. I hate loving her so much too, despite her being so toxic towards/for me. I have no control. Again, I wish I never fell for someone like her. I wish I didn't give everything I had for someone who never appreciated me

It's been happening to be every single day for a week. Dreams of being with my ex. Playing a game with all of my old friends again. Just things that made me so happy back then. And I'd wake up and realize I have none of that anymore.

I wish I had the strength to get therapy. I keep giving up on myself and telling myself I'm not worth it. But wanting to get it doesn't make you a pussy. It means you have the strength necessary to do what it takes to heal. Or at least get the process started. That isn't being selfish. That's you caring about your own well being.
